parent_objective: implement bounded public source retargeting after M1513 design
blocked_by: retargeted source traces are needed before measured intervention or candidate materialization
supersedes: manual retargeting or unbounded random search

public_gates: M1514 must implement bounded retarget spec generation
M1514 must run a small public retarget smoke with fixed checkpoint
M1514 must write retarget spec trace snapshot summary and guardrail artifacts
M1514 must compare retarget margins against M1511 baseline margins
M1514 must not materialize candidates or export a training corpus
M1514 must not train run PPO promote use private holdout or alter actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run unbounded random search
do not claim self-identification from retargeted traces

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements bounded source retargeting and a small public fixed-policy smoke after M1513 design
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: retarget implementation and public trace movement only; no candidate materialization, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if retarget generation violates P0 actor contract
stop if smoke cannot remain bounded to <=24 specs
stop if artifacts cannot compare retarget margins against M1511 baseline
stop if implementation would materialize candidates or export a corpus
fallback_plan: if retarget smoke is too easy, route to retarget result audit and source repair
if retarget smoke is too hard, route to cap tuning audit
if retarget smoke produces near-boundary traces, route to trace audit before measured interventions

admission_evidence: M1513 designed bounded retarget axes and caps after M1512 found the first traces too safe
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up retarget audit or blocker manifest
next_stage_criteria: margin movement vs M1511 is explicit
next audit or blocker is explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1514 may create harder scenarios but still does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: retargeted traces must preserve reveal decision and post-decision windows for later interventions
do not claim history necessity without measured wrong/delayed/current-tiled margins
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: bounded retargeted public source traces only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If retargeted traces remain too safe or too hard, route to audit or repair rather than materializing weak candidates.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: Bounded retargeted source specs can reduce margins and improve label diversity relative to M1511 while keeping the P0 actor contract and no-training guardrails.
success_criteria: retarget smoke attempts <=24 specs and all six source families
retarget summary compares margins against M1511 baseline
candidate_materialized training replay PPO promotion private holdout and actor-input changes remain false
failure_criteria: retarget module or tests are missing
retarget smoke is unbounded or uses private holdout
retarget artifacts cannot compare margins against M1511
candidate materialization corpus export training PPO promotion private holdout or actor-input changes occur
decision_rule: M1514 passes if bounded retargeting runs a small public fixed-policy smoke with complete artifacts and all guardrails false.
